title: Provisional Decision Record
description: Closed serialized event shape for provisional decisions. The replay evaluator separately verifies authorship, source and claim freshness, and transition authority.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this serialized event contract.

recordId.description: Stable identity for this immutable event record.

source.description: Repository and issue identity with the source snapshot bound to the decision.

repository.description: Owner and repository slug whose issue carries the decision.

issueNumber.description: Source issue number, bounded to JavaScript's safe-integer range.

snapshot.description: The issue title, body digest, and update time captured for this decision.

title.description: Source issue title at the recorded snapshot.

bodySha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 digest of the source issue body.

updatedAt.description: GitHub update time for the source issue snapshot.

bundleGeneration.description: Positive generation of the current decision bundle.

decisionGeneration.description: Positive generation of this decision within its bundle.

claimId.description: Opaque ID of a claim in the source issue's verified lineage.

agentId.description: Agent identity recorded for this claim.

branch.description: Canonical implementation branch for this claim.

claimedAt.description: GitHub creation time for the claim marker.

supersedes.description: Prior claim ID superseded by this claim, when this is a takeover.

claimLineage.description: Claim identities in lineage order; the replay evaluator verifies them against trusted claim evidence.

evidenceReferences.description: Links to evidence only; a URL does not grant authority or replace independent verification.

event.description: One immutable event in the provisional-decision lifecycle.

type.description: Marks the event that records a provisional option selection.

question.description: The product, technical, or scope question answered by this decision.

selectedOption.description: The feasible option selected for provisional execution.

id.description: Stable ID used to refer to the selected option.

description.description: Human-readable behavior of the selected option.

feasibilityRationale.description: Why the selected option is feasible within the stated constraints.

requirementFit.description: How the selected option meets the source issue's requirements.

consequences.description: Expected consequences of selecting this option.

verification.description: How the selected option's result can be checked.

reversalOrMigration.description: Reversal or migration work required by this option, or why none is required.

rationale.description: Why the selected option best fits the recorded evidence and requirements.

feasibleAlternatives.description: Feasible options compared and rejected in favor of the selected option.

id.description: Stable ID used to refer to this alternative.

feasibilityRationale.description: Why this alternative can be implemented within the stated constraints.

requirementFit.description: How this alternative meets the source issue's requirements.

consequences.description: Expected consequences of choosing this alternative.

verification.description: How this alternative's result could be checked.

reversalOrMigration.description: Reversal or migration work required by this alternative, or why none is required.

comparison.description: How this alternative compares with the selected option.

rejectionReason.description: Why this feasible alternative was not selected.

executionCriteria.description: Objective conditions that must be met before the provisional work counts as complete.

type.description: Marks the event that binds the decision to ongoing implementation.

startedAt.description: Time the implementation work was recorded as started.

planReference.description: Link to the reviewed implementation plan for this decision.

type.description: Marks the event that records verified completion evidence.

result.description: The deliverable and evidence used to verify completed work.

reference.description: Link to the deliverable or its authoritative record.

verifiedAt.description: Time the deliverable was independently verified.

reference.description: Link to the deliverable or its authoritative record.

verifiedAt.description: Time the deliverable was independently verified.

type.description: Marks an event that records an explicit human confirmation.

confirmation.description: Reference and answer for the current completed decision bundle.

commentUrl.description: Link to the issue comment carrying the confirmation answer.

response.description: Affirmative response accepted by the lifecycle.

confirmedAt.description: GitHub creation time of the confirmation comment.

confirmedBy.description: Display metadata only; replay verifies the actual comment author and does not infer human intent from a shared login.

type.description: Marks an event that records the operator's request to use another option.

reworkRequest.description: The alternate option and rationale requested for same-source rework.

commentUrl.description: Link to the issue comment that requests the alternate choice.

requestedAt.description: GitHub creation time of the rework request comment.

requestedOptionId.description: Stable ID of the alternate option selected by the operator.

rationale.description: Why the operator requests rework using the alternate option.

type.description: Marks an event that records publication of the same-source rework roadmap.

reworkRoadmap.description: Identity and link for the authored rework roadmap on the source issue.

roadmapIssueNumber.description: Source issue number after it becomes the rework roadmap.

roadmapMarkerId.description: Roadmap identity marker recorded in the source issue body.

authoringSetId.description: Authoring set identity for the held rework children.

url.description: Link to the same issue after it is published as a roadmap.
